name: fathomdb
description: TypeScript SDK for FathomDB — napi-rs binding to fathomdb-engine
//files: 0.8.20 Slice 39 (R-20-DOC). The release build is `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json` (rootDir src) -> dist/index.js. But `npm test` runs `tsc -p tsconfig.json` (rootDir '.') which emits dist/src/** AND dist/tests/**; packing over that stale tree shipped 97 files, 84 of them compiled tests, with the runtime at the wrong path (dist/src/index.js, so `main` was broken). Measured with `npm pack --dry-run`. The two negations make that structurally unshippable: the same stale tree now packs 2 files (LICENSE + package.json), which fails loudly instead of publishing test cruft. LICENSE is a REAL FILE, not a symlink: npm's automatic license inclusion silently skips a symlink (measured — `npm pack` produced no LICENSE entry at all). scripts/check-license-consistency.sh asserts it stays byte-identical to the repo-root LICENSE.
//napi-platform-split: R-REL-4f. Thin main package: ships NO .node. Each host's binary is a separate unscoped fathomdb-<triple> package (src/ts/npm/<triple>/) carrying os/cpu, resolved by the loader in src/ts/src/platform.ts. optionalDependencies are INJECTED at publish time by scripts/release/npm-inject-optional-deps.sh (one entry per published platform, pinned to this version) so the committed package-lock.json stays in sync with `npm ci`. Linux x64 and arm64 glibc packages publish under a non-latest dist-tag (NPM_DIST_TAG); the follow-on adds the remaining platforms and promotes latest.

scripts.test: npm run build:native:debug && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js
